title: The Collective Provides: 2,500 cr once, the link after Network Expansion; 20 nickel ore mined at Rotanev Daylight Seam, handed in at Central Nexus
note: Architect Vex-9 on the Central Nexus board, the link after Network Expansion: mine 20 nickel ore, 2,500 cr once, voidborn mastery XP. No home field holds nickel; GSC-0049 Platinum-Group Reef (lawless, 5 jumps) read 192 nickel at 07:47 UTC, Gliese 876 618 (a pirate seen there at 04:40 UTC, Intel). Test by hand, one trader, 08:47 to 09:32 UTC: hold stored at Central Nexus, accepted, mined at the reef, handed in at Central Nexus: RESULT +2,188 cr after fuel in 48 minutes (data/routes/runs.jsonl). The reef gives nickel, platinum, rhodium, osmium and iridium together: the hold filled with 14 nickel among 58 units, the mining loop took it home to storage and went back, so a run is two trips. The other ores have no bid above 2 cr at our stations (books of 09:05 UTC): stored, not sold. The hand-in opens a tree of voidborn mastery missions on the same board: The Signal Protocol, Crystal Resonance Harvest, Deep Core Prospecting, Atmospheric Extraction: Setup, Material Synthesis: Basic, Network Commerce Protocol, Hardware Optimization: Cargo, Threat Neutralization Protocol (not flown: it asks to destroy a pirate, orders F2). requires.booked Network Expansion; max_ships 2 while the reef's nickel is the only read source within reach. Stamped 2026-11-16 09:34 UTC. 2026-11-16 12:34 UTC: off. The reef read nickel_ore 0 of 18,000 and platinum 0 of 7,000 at 11:54 UTC (data/scouting/gsc_0049.json; pilots of two other factions met there); a run started 11:16 UTC ended 'objectives not done' after 54.7 minutes, -338 cr. The only other nickel we read is Gliese 876 Belt, 659 of 12,000 among about 7,000 iron and carbon ore, 7 jumps (census 08:49 UTC): about 9 in 100 units mined would be nickel, three holds or more a run with no station to store at. On again when a census reads nickel at the reef; a field floor on the mine step is asked of the Fleet Admiral. 2026-11-17 11:40 UTC (Mercury, orders ENT-036 task 2, rules F34 and F35): on again as a test with one ship, the field moved to Rotanev Daylight Seam: 424 nickel ore and nothing else (census of 2026-11-17 00:46 UTC, table fields), 10 jumps by Node Beta, GSC-0027, GSC-0050, Brachium, Nightveil, Marfik, Regor, Groombridge 34 and Chalawan, none of them with a pirate on our record (observations, kind pirate). Not Gliese 876 Belt (635 nickel among iron and carbon, 7 jumps): a pirate stood at that belt at 05:13 UTC and 37 pirate battles are on the public record there (orders D9: our ships avoid pirates). Not Jadecove (609, pure nickel): its road crosses Gliese 876. A pure field fills the 20 in one hold. Read by Mining: admirals.log ENT-029.
